semiconductor_relevance: High — ERS Electronic GmbH specializes in thermal management solutions critical for testing and packaging in the semiconductor industry.
summary: ERS Electronic GmbH provides innovative thermal test solutions, including fast-ramping and precise low-noise thermal systems for the semiconductor industry. Their products support both analytical and manufacturing processes, particularly in advanced packaging applications.
capabilities: Fast-ramping thermal chuck systems for temperatures from -65°C to +550°C
Fully automatic debonders for wafer-level packaging
Warpage adjust tools for Fan-Out Wafer-Level-Package (FOWLP) technologies
Custom thermal-forcing systems for complex thermal applications

regional_presence.Germany: Headquartered in Germering, near Munich, with engineering and production facilities.
regional_presence.United States: Has support offices to cater to the North American market.
regional_presence.Singapore: Maintains a support office to serve the Asian market.
regional_presence.Taiwan: Operates a support office to assist local semiconductor manufacturers.
